description: Source code for a Lighttpd module 'mod_evhost' that dynamically sets document root paths based on the host in the request, using configurable path patterns with placeholders for domain components.

classes.name: plugin_config
classes.description: Structure holding path pattern pieces for the plugin.

classes.name: plugin_data
classes.description: Main plugin data structure including configuration and split values.

methods.name: mod_evhost_free_path_pieces
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for path pattern pieces.

methods.name: mod_evhost_parse_pattern_err
methods.description: Handles errors during pattern parsing, frees allocated buffers.

methods.name: mod_evhost_parse_pattern
methods.description: Parses a pattern string into path pieces with placeholders.

methods.name: mod_evhost_merge_config_cpv
methods.description: Merges a single configuration value into plugin config.

methods.name: mod_evhost_merge_config
methods.description: Merges multiple configuration values into plugin config.

methods.name: mod_evhost_patch_config
methods.description: Applies configuration patches based on request conditions.

methods.name: mod_evhost_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration for the plugin.

methods.name: mod_evhost_parse_host
methods.description: Parses the host header into domain components.

methods.name: mod_evhost_build_doc_root_path
methods.description: Builds the document root path based on host and pattern.

methods.name: mod_evhost_uri_handler
methods.description: Handles requests to set the document root based on host.

methods.name: mod_evhost_plugin_init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin and registers hooks.
